documents.title: St. Francis County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 8 pages. Amounts are the 2026 Budgeted Expenses (Exhibit A); not carry-forward, projected revenue or 2025 budgeted column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
